exposure: gestational weight gain above the Institute of Medicine guidelines
outcome: Successful trial of labor (TOL) following two cesarean deliveries (CDs)
cohort: Term, nonanomalous, singleton, vertex pregnancies attempting a VBAC following a history of two previous CDs in the United States from 2012 to 2014
finding: Previous vaginal delivery and delivery at 40-41 weeks gestation were associated with successful VBAC, while older maternal age, lower education level, Medicaid insurance, non-Caucasian race/ethnicity, overweight or obesity, and excessive gestational weight gain were associated with repeat CD.
